title: typing cairn in PowerShell runs the cairn command
intention: From PowerShell on Windows, cairn <verb> reaches bin/cairn through cairn.cmd and prints what the shell-side command prints.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: bin/cairn is a shell script; running it from PowerShell gave a SyntaxError; bin/cairn.cmd exists as a shim
traces_to: CP4 and Law 3: a command that works only from Git Bash is a box-specific gap; the measurement comes before the fix.
how: Measure how PowerShell resolves cairn today; then make the entry resolve to bin/cairn.cmd (name, PATHEXT or a documented shim) and prove it by running a harmless verb with no console window left open.

clauses.claim: from PowerShell, cairn resolves to bin/cairn.cmd
cairn with a read-only verb exits 0 and prints the same first line as from Git Bash

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: bin/cairn is a shell script; running it from PowerShell gave a SyntaxError; bin/cairn.cmd exists as a shim
measured.how: orchestrator report plus ls bin/ (how PowerShell resolves cairn is not measured: HYPOTHESIS that it does not reach the .cmd)

measured.saw: From PowerShell on akiendell, Get-Command cairn -All lists bin\cairn.cmd first and the extensionless bin\cairn second; (Get-Command cairn).Source is bin\cairn.cmd, in this session and in a fresh powershell -NoProfile. PATHEXT carries .CMD and bin is on PATH. The ticket's HYPOTHESIS that PowerShell does not reach the .cmd is FALSIFIED. The source of the observed SyntaxError is UNKNOWN (possibly a direct ./bin/cairn or python bin/cairn). Clause 2 (a read-only verb exits 0, same first line as Git Bash) is UNMEASURED: running cairn executes bin/cairn, whose lazy-init spawns windows and waits on Akien's word.
measured.how: Get-Command cairn -All; (Get-Command cairn).Source; powershell -NoProfile -Command (Get-Command cairn).Source; $env:PATHEXT; bin/cairn.cmd read, not run

orient.request: dc945eb1f072: from PowerShell on Windows, cairn reaches bin/cairn through cairn.cmd and prints what the shell-side command prints
orient.intent: A proof pins that PATHEXT resolution over bin/ picks cairn.cmd, and that a read-only verb through cairn.cmd exits 0 with the same first line as Git Bash; bin/cairn.cmd itself needs no change.
orient.scope: bin/cairn.cmd is read, not written; one new proof under bin/proofs; every other component is out

the ticket's hypothesis that PowerShell does not reach the .cmd was falsified by Get-Command cairn -All; the source of the earlier SyntaxError is UNKNOWN
the posix side was not run: tooth 1 is Windows-only and says UNRAN elsewhere

Nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass.
